questions.explanation_english:
The motto Satyameva Jayate, meaning Truth
Alone Triumphs, is the national motto of India.
Inscribed in Devanagari script at the base of
the State Emblem of India below the abacus, it
originates from a famous verse in the Mundaka
Upanishad. The phrase emphasizes the ultimate
victory of truth and moral righteousness, serving
as a core philosophical pillar of the Indian
Republic and its governance.

questions.explanation_english: Sir C.V. Raman was awarded the Nobel Prize in Physics in 1930 for his pioneering research on the scattering of light. This phenomenon is now famously known as the Raman Effect.

To mark the formal adoption of the Indian Constitution by the Constituent Assembly of India

questions.question_english: 46. Who was the first woman to receive the Bharat Ratna?
questions.explanation_english: Indira Gandhi became the first woman to be honored with the Bharat Ratna, India’s highest civilian award, in 1971. Serving as the Prime Minister of India, she was recognized for her decisive leadership during the Indo-Pakistani War of 1971, which led to the liberation of Bangladesh. Subsequent female recipients of the Bharat Ratna include Mother Teresa, Aruna Asaf Ali, and M.S. Subbulakshmi.

questions.question_english: 95. Which iconic building in Hyderabad was constructed in 1591 by Muhammad Quli Qutb Shah to commemorate the eradication of plague?
questions.explanation_english: The Charminar is a world-renowned monument and mosque constructed in 1591 in Hyderabad by Muhammad Quli Qutb Shah, the fifth ruler of the Qutb Shahi dynasty. questions.explanation_english: Speed Post was introduced by the Department of Posts in India in August 1986. Created to provide fast, reliable, and time-bound delivery of letters, documents, and parcels across domestic and international networks, the service modernized India’s postal infrastructure. It offered real-time tracking, doorstep collection, and guaranteed delivery times, enabling India Post to compete effectively with emerging private courier services.
